name: Thousand Venom Valley — Mouth
description: The road narrows into a cleft between gray cliffs. Seven black steles stand unevenly where travellers are meant to turn back. Mist coils along the ground, and the air itself tastes faintly of copper. A low chanting — or is it only the wind? — drifts from deeper in.
first_visit_text: The steles are old. The oldest warns, in a script carved by no hand the empire teaches:  'Beyond this stone, only the welcome and the dying pass.' The second has been defaced, recently — by someone with a clean sword and an uncertain grip.

name: Venom Gorge
description: Cliff walls close overhead in a green half-light. Water drips from vine to stone with a sound like clocks. Spiders the size of a child's fist tend their webs in silence, and from the rocks a chorus of unseen frogs keeps time. The path forks: east into deeper stone; north along a ladder of roots.

name: Hall of Five Poisons
description: A hall carved into the living cliff, its pillars wound with living vines. Five bronze basins ring the central floor — each holds a living thing: viper, centipede, toad, scorpion, spider — and each, in turn, drinks a ladle of dark wine from an attendant in grey. In a chair of lacquered bone, the Matriarch receives all who are brave enough to be received.
first_visit_text: No one stops you at the door. No one, you realise, is going to. The attendant with the ladle raises their head and — without hurry — smiles. In this hall, the courtesy is yours to keep.

name: The Poisoner's Garden
description: A terraced garden cut into the gorge wall, walled by iron-black lattice. Every plant is a killer, beautifully arranged: oleander by monkshood, datura by black lotus. A small bronze censer breathes a sweet-sour smoke. Cultivating here is a test of the lungs as much as the dantian. In three of the iron-lattice corners — where the wind's geometry denies even a seed its landing — the stone is empty of plant, and pale.
